units.source_text: 但是，我面前的铁丝网窗口下面，就堆放着装着雏人偶的桐木箱子。

en.t: But below the wire-mesh window in front of me, paulownia boxes holding hina dolls were piled up.

units.source_text: 过了今晚，这些箱子就会被送到住在横滨的外国人家里……搞不好还会远渡重洋到美国。

en.t: After tonight, these boxes would be sent to the homes of foreigners living in Yokohama, and perhaps even cross the ocean to America.

units.source_text: 我越想越觉得无法忍受。

en.t: The more I thought about it, the more unbearable it felt.

units.source_text: 等母亲熟睡的时候，我悄悄跑到店里。

en.t: When my mother had fallen fast asleep, I quietly ran to the shop.

units.source_text: 虽然店里的阳光照射不太好。

en.t: Although the sunlight did not reach the shop very well.

units.source_text: 但是比起仓库来，至少可以看到路上的行人，明朗的多。

en.t: Still, compared with the storeroom, I could at least see people passing along the road, so it was much brighter.

units.source_text: 那个时候，父亲正在核对账目，哥哥正在认真的将甘草之类的药物放进药碾。

en.t: At that time, Father was checking the accounts, and my elder brother was carefully putting licorice root and other medicines into the mortar.
